title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ProductCatalog
description: A collection of Product Offerings, intended for a specific DistributionChannel, enhanced with additional information such as SLA parameters, invoicing and shipping details (TM Forum TMF620 Product Catalog Management 5.0.0, OpenAPI component ProductCatalog; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ProductCatalog:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ProductCatalog'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'ProductCatalog' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Addressable/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:ProductCatalog:<tmfId>. unique identifier

catalogType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Catalog/properties/catalogType'. Type of this Catalog, like Product, Service, Resource etc.

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Catalog/properties/validFor'. A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Catalog/properties/relatedParty'. List of parties involved in this catalog

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Catalog/properties/lastUpdate'. Date and time of the last update

lifecycleStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Catalog/properties/lifecycleStatus'. Used to indicate the current lifecycle status

category.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductCatalog/properties/category'. List of root categories contained in this catalog. In TMF this is an array of CategoryRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced Category entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Category:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

allOf.description: Entity reference schema to be use for all entityRef class.

id.description: The identifier of the referred entity.

href.description: The URI of the referred entity.

@referredType.description: The actual type of the target instance when needed for disambiguation.

Extensible.description: Base Extensible schema for use in TMForum Open-APIs - When used for in a schema it means that the Entity described by the schema MUST be extended with the @type

@type.description: When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

allOf.description: Party role reference. A party role represents the part played by a party in a given context.

partyId.description: The identifier of the engaged party that is linked to the PartyRole object.

partyName.description: The name of the engaged party that is linked to the PartyRole object.

allOf.description: RelatedParty reference. A related party defines party or party role or its reference, linked to a specific entity

role.description: Role played by the related party or party role in the context of the specific entity it is linked to. Such as 'initiator', 'customer', 'salesAgent', 'user'

TimePeriod.description: A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

startDateTime.description: Start of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format

endDateTime.description: End of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format
